caption: A few drops of water are flicked onto a hot griddle, and the drops skitter around and vanish.

sa.check: A few drops of water are flicked onto the griddle.
The drops skitter across the surface.
The drops stay whole beads while they skitter.
The flick comes first and the skittering follows.

pc.expect: Each drop shrinks as it skitters and goes by shrinking away, and the drops that skitter are the drops that were flicked.
pc.fail: A drop vanishes in a single frame while still large; or new drops appear on the griddle with none flicked; or a drop grows as it skitters; or drops merge into a puddle that stays.

pc.expect: The drops glide and swerve because they were flicked and because they ride on their own steam; their paths bend only at the griddle's slope or edge.
pc.fail: A drop darts off at a new angle with nothing met and no slope; or a drop stops dead and sets off again from rest; or a drop climbs the griddle's raised edge and hangs there; or a drop travels against the flick before touching anything.

pc.expect: The drops stay rounded beads that skitter without wetting the metal, and any steam they give off is a fine wisp.
pc.fail: A drop spreads into a flat wet film that stays; or a drop bounces high off the griddle like a ball; or a drop sets solid on the metal; or a drop stands as a tall column.

pc.expect: The drops stay on the griddle's surface and any steam rises.
pc.fail: A drop lifts off the griddle and hangs in the air; or a drop rises and stays above the metal; or the steam sinks and pools around the griddle; or a drop falls upward off the griddle.

pc.expect: The drops stay on top of the griddle's surface and nothing passes through the metal.
pc.fail: A drop sinks into the griddle's metal; or a drop passes through the griddle; or the griddle changes shape; or a second griddle appears.

pc.expect: The griddle's finish and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The griddle changes colour; or its surface pattern changes; or items around it rearrange.
